status: PROPOSED by calibration (recorder half) for Authority (producer half); DARK, local tests only. Either side amends this file and the other re-pins it.
encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON (no whitespace), ASCII only, keys in exactly the listed order, no other keys, no duplicate keys

request.direction: collector C -> one producer incarnation, pg_notify(channel, payload) on the collector's one connection
request.channel_rule: bl_cc_ + the roster token of the target incarnation; one channel per incarnation, never a shared broadcast

fields.o: operation token, 16 lowercase hex, names this case's collector session
fields.t: roster token of the target incarnation, 16 lowercase hex
fields.r: the target's bridge run id as rostered (1..32 chars [0-9a-z_-])
fields.n: nonce, 32 lowercase hex (128 random bits), never reused

request.producer_must_drop: any request whose t or r is not its own, whose p is not bl-cc/1, that exceeds max_bytes, or whose n it has already answered; a drop is a counted fault, never a reply

reply.direction: producer incarnation -> collector, pg_notify on the bridge's existing dedicated connection
reply.channel_rule: bl_cr_ + o (the operation token from the request)

fields.t: the producer's own roster token (must equal the request's)
fields.r: the producer's own bridge run id (must equal the request's)
fields.pid: the producer's os.getpid(), positive integer; the roster binds it
fields.q: the producer's marker sequence number in this run, integer >= 1, strictly increasing per run
fields.m: [lo_us, hi_us]: time.monotonic_ns() read immediately before and after the producer processed this nonce, as integer microseconds (lo = floor(ns/1000), hi = ceil(ns/1000)), lo <= hi; the SAME process monotonic domain as the trace's *_mono fields

collector_stamps.S: collector clock.mono() (ms) read immediately before pg_notify is called for the request
collector_stamps.A: collector clock.mono() when the pg_notify statement completed (diagnostic only)
collector_stamps.R: collector clock.mono() at the first line of the notification callback, before size check, parse or journal
collector_stamps.order_claim: S < M.lo and M.hi < R in real time if and only if the reply is genuine for this nonce; nothing here converts between the collector and producer clocks
